post.title: Why Your Worst Trip Is Now Your Favourite Story #shorts
post.description: What was your worst trip? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend from that trip. Arthur finds a photo of the worst holiday ever (rain all week, a flooded tent) and he's smiling. In 'Autobiographical Memory: Unpleasantness Fades Faster Than Pleasantness Over Time' (Applied Cognitive Psychology, 1997), W. Richard Walker, Rodney Vogl and Charles Thompson had people keep diaries of real events and rate how they felt; rated again later, the bad feelings attached to memories had faded faster than the good ones. Psychologists call it the fading affect bias. It's how bad days turn into good stories. #psychology #shorts #memory #fadingaffectbias #overthinking
